kypExtensions.summary: The four-move stratification protocol the page implies but never states as a sequence: (1) STATE the crude association (both phenomena begin as an identical crude link — coffee-cancer; OCP-DVT); (2) TEST the third variable (two links + the pathway exclusion); (3) STRATIFY and compare the strata with each other and with the crude estimate; (4) DELIVER the verdict and act — COLLAPSE (association gone in every stratum) = confounding, remove it; SPLIT (real but different across strata) = effect modification, report it. The 'collapse vs split' rule and the 'remove vs report' action pairing are the KYP synthesis of the two printed rows.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two rows as parallel facts plus two worked examples; the ordered protocol, the collapse-vs-split router, and the remove-vs-report action pairing are KYP's organization.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVES 1-4 + mechanisms[0] confounding-collapse-map + mechanisms[1] effect-modification-split-map + blocks[3] the steps block + the visual's KYP rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The three-role router for any third variable in any stem: upstream common cause of both exposure and outcome, not on the causal pathway = CONFOUNDER (remove); downstream consequence of the exposure transmitting the effect = MEDIATOR (do not adjust — the printed parenthetical '(not on a causal pathway)' exists to exclude this); variable that changes the size/direction of a true effect across subgroups = EFFECT MODIFIER (test for interaction, then stratify and report). Plus the smoking double-role observation: the same variable is the confounder in the coffee-lung-cancer story and the modifier in the OCP-DVT story — the role belongs to the relationship, not the variable.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the confounder definition (with its parenthetical) and the two smoking examples; the explicit mediator category, the three-way router, and the role-not-variable principle are KYP's framing.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + core.keyIdea MOVE 2 + blocks[2] the decoder list (ROW 1 and the smoking double role) + usmle.traps[1] confounder vs mediator + usmle.pivots[0]

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the stratified-collapse coffee-cancer stem, the stratified-split OCP-DVT stem, the crossover self-control strategy stem, the pathway-exclusion mediator stem), 4 traps (confounding vs effect modification; confounder vs mediator; effect modification is not a bias despite the printed column header; matching vs stratified analysis), 3 pivots (the third-variable role router, the collapse-vs-split estimate reader, the technique-selector), and 8 recall cards covering both rows, both examples, all four strategies, and the legend.

kypExtensions.summary: The clinical anchor layer: the two printed example threads — the coffee-lung-cancer thread (smoking the true cause of bronchogenic carcinoma; any crude lifestyle-association with a smoking-related outcome deserves stratification) and the OCP-DVT thread (estrogen-associated thromboembolic risk amplified by smoking — why smoking status shapes contraceptive counseling) — plus the boundary framing (confounding is a VALIDITY problem: the crude estimate is wrong, remove it; effect modification is a DISCOVERY: the crude estimate is an average of two truths, report it) and the miniCase (the OCP-DVT interaction-test vignette routed to effect modification/stratified reporting against the confounding, regression-pooling, mediator, and selection-bias distractors).
kypExtensions.rationale: The examples themselves are printed (FA-own); the thread organization, the remove-vs-report boundary framing, the pharmacologic smoking-estrogen context, and the miniCase with its distractors are KYP's design, flagged as such.
